objective: Independently confirm the two marginal estimands from the untouched five-panel factorial with maximum remaining disjoint official BABILong QA1-QA3 panels.

panel_selection.ordering: ascending SHA-256 of canonical official rows

primary_analysis.interval: two-sided Student-t 95% interval over ten untouched panels (df=9)
primary_analysis.gate: All provenance/alignment checks pass and all four two-sided 95% lower confidence bounds are strictly positive.

stopping_rule: Run all 50 focused cells and report every panel and estimand without panel, task, prediction, or outlier deletion.
interpretation_rule: This is a prospective independent confirmation of the two marginal estimands, not a retroactive pass of the failed five-panel primary gate. The earlier five-panel outcome remains reported unchanged.
promotion_rule: Promotion requires the focused primary gate plus an independent model or task family; statistical significance alone is not described as far beyond TNNLS.
